title: A role built like the Local Purchase or International Purchase preset is saved with more permissions than the form selects
summary: When a role is saved exactly as the role form builds the Local Purchase preset (58 permissions selected), the backend stores extra permissions: purchase order and requisition approve/create/delete/edit, vendor bill view/create/edit/delete/approve, material requisition view and the international order and requisition view. International Purchase gets the mirror (local view permissions). The role then reaches records the form's Access Summary says it cannot: a Local Purchase user gets 200 on vendor bills, related records, previews and material requisitions; an International Purchase user gets 200 on GET /api/purchase/requisitions.
steps: Settings > Users & Roles > New role: pick the Local Purchase preset and save.
Open the saved role's permission list and compare with the 58 selected.
Sign in as a user with that role and call GET /api/purchase/vendor-bills/1.
expected: The role holds exactly the permissions selected in the form.
actual: The role holds extra purchase permissions (permission expansion on save) and reaches vendor bills and requisitions it should not.
where: Backend: role save / permission expansion (companion-permission rules). Frontend: role form Access Summary shows the smaller set.
verify: Save the Local Purchase preset and read the stored permissions: equal to the selection; vendor-bill GET answers 403.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: Pending Actions drops a pending purchase requisition that has no document date when a date range is set
summary: GET /api/dashboard/pending-actions returns a pending purchase requisition with docDate null, and any date range removes it: with from/to set the total and every module count are 0. The card opens on the current month, so the Purchase tab shows 0 and the list is empty until the user clears the dates.
steps: Create a purchase requisition and leave it pending.
Open the dashboard Pending Actions card on its default (this month) range.
Clear the dates on the card.
expected: The requisition counts in the current month and is listed.
actual: Count 0 and an empty list until the dates are cleared.
where: Backend: dashboard pending-actions query (requisition docDate is null at that stage, date filter excludes it).
verify: With the default range the Purchase tab counts the pending requisition.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: Accounts Payable card and KPI (ledger) do not match the A/P Aging Summary report
summary: The Accounts Payable card and the Payables KPI show 407,623.69 while the A/P Aging Summary (POST /api/reports/VENDOR_AGING, built from bills) shows 45,436.19, a difference of 362,187.50. The trial balance has Sundry Creditors 2111 at 375,946.19 and 2112 at 33,877.50. A bill the test makes moves card, KPI and report by exactly its total, so the gap is in older documents; goods received but not billed may be posted to the vendor in the ledger and be absent from the bill report (not verified). Receivables agree.
steps: Run the e2e stack with its seeded and test documents.
Compare the dashboard Accounts Payable card with the A/P Aging Summary total.
expected: Both read the same payable (or the difference is explained on screen).
actual: 407,623.69 on the card against 45,436.19 in the report.
where: Backend: ledger-based payable (2111/2112) against the bill-based aging report; dashboard aging card query.
verify: Card and report totals agree, or the card says it includes goods received not billed.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as test.fail() with a BUG comment.

title: Parallel requests as a freshly created role user stall for 30 seconds and some answer 401 once
summary: With 16 parallel GETs as a newly made role user, about 15 requests wait exactly 30 seconds (/api/sales/orders, /api/sales/receipts/1, /api/sales/postings/triggers and others). Single requests also answer 401 once and then succeed on retry (inventory-account-mappings/write-offs, material-requisitions/1, lc/1/landed-cost, invoices/by-customer/1). A pool starved by permission lookups is the likely cause (30 s is a typical pool timeout); not verified. At 4 parallel requests there are no stalls and no 401. A screen that fires parallel requests could be logged out by the 401.
steps: Create a role and a user, sign in as that user.
Send 16 GET requests at once to different sales and purchase endpoints.
expected: All answer promptly; no 401 for a valid token.
actual: About 15 of 16 stall 30 s; some single calls give 401 first.
where: Backend: authentication / permission lookup and the datasource pool (see also e2e:platform:connection-pool-starvation).
verify: 16 parallel requests as a fresh role user all answer within a second or two with no 401.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as a probe at concurrency 4 with a 401 re-check.

title: SSO initiate and HRMS employee lookup take about 42 seconds when the external system is unreachable
summary: GET /api/auth/sso/initiate (502) and GET /api/admin/users/hrms-employees (400) answer after about 42 seconds on the test stack because the external systems are missing, which freezes the screens that call them for that long.
steps: Call GET /api/admin/users/hrms-employees with the HRMS not reachable.
expected: A quick, readable failure (a few seconds, with a clear message).
where: Backend: HTTP client timeout for the HRMS and SSO calls.
verify: The call fails within about 5 seconds with a clear message.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as a check that only asserts the refusal.

title: The empty dashboard shows its hint but not the title 'Your dashboard is empty'
summary: When every card is hidden the dashboard draws the hint text but not the title the message set defines for this state.
steps: Dashboard > Personalize: hide every card and save.
expected: The title and the hint are shown.
verify: The empty state shows the title.
status_evidence: Found by the role-matrix port and the new dashboard e2e suite, 2026-11-14; kept as an assertion on the hint only.
